_comment: Scaling-source widening -- FIXED 2026-08-10 (MTG_DOMAIN_WIDEN=0 restores the gap, and the verdict then reads 'illegal: no untapped source produces black mana'). Two scaling dorks (domain {G,W}) + Breeding Pool + Jetmir's Garden = 6 mana but NO black. Cosmic Spider-Man {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} is payable only via the widening: tap Bloom Tender for {G}, cast Deathrite Shaman {B/G}, the domain gains BLACK, and Faeburrow Elder then taps {W}{B}{G} which with the two lands is exactly WUBRG. ASSERTED VIA validate_line, NOT a win turn: turn == max_turns here, so a creature cast on the final turn is worth nothing against a passive goldfish and the search rightly just attacks -- no win-turn assertion can see this at all. Two things had to change: the per-subset widening credit in EnumeratePlans (the flat pool is state-only, so it killed the subset before the colour gate was ever consulted) and hybrid-carrying cost accumulation (Deathrite's {B/G} bakes into BLACK, so a flat sum of the widener's own cost demanded a colour the un-widened board cannot make). Raise max_turns to 9 and the executor plays it for real: Spider-Man lands on T6 instead of T7, which is what lets Progenitus follow on T7. See docs/design/scaling-source-widening.md.
